title: Satin with PE-DESIGN's second under sewing type: the edge run, then two layers of lines at the direction minus and plus 45 degrees
description: The under sewing sweep's satin with Under sewing on and the second type button (the icon of a double layer of crossing rows), Density Medium. PE-DESIGN 11.50 sews the running stitch 1 mm inside the outline from the start point, then two layers of parallel lines 1 mm inside the outline, 2 mm apart, at the sewing direction minus 45 degrees and then plus 45 degrees, in 4 mm stitches; each layer in two halves from the region's far corners towards the start point (lines one spacing in from each corner up to the line through the start point), travelling straight to the corner in 2.5 mm stitches, walking the inset outline between lines in two stitches, and walking back to the start point; then the top stitching. OpenStitch: underlayStyle cross.

featureMatrix.feature: Satin: a zigzag across the column

evidence.note: PE-DESIGN 11.50 reference compat/reference/stitches/sweep-satin-us-type-2.pes (2026-10-27): 404 stitches as the harness counts them; lines on a lattice anchored one 2 mm spacing in from each far corner (28 units along the inset edges), joins of 2 x 1.4 mm, inside travel of 2.4-2.5 mm, the half before the start point sewn first in each layer.

references.make: On a 100 × 100 mm Design Page (grid 1 mm, Snap to Grid) draw a 40 × 6 mm rectangle with the Rectangle tool from (10, 10) to (50, 16) mm. Line Not Sewn; colour 800 RED; region sew type Satin Stitch, Direction Manual straight line 90°, Under sewing ticked (first type, Density Medium), Density 4.5, Pull compensation 0.0 mm, Half Stitch at its default, every other attribute at PE-DESIGN's default. Save with Save As as PES (PE-DESIGN 11's default PES version) under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting you changed in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md). Under sewing on, the second type button (the icon of a double layer of crossing rows), Density Medium.
